Container.Name: FocusAssistant
Container.Overview: Focus Assistant is an ADHD-friendly productivity app featuring task management with the Eisenhower Matrix, a Pomodoro timer, daily planning, weekly reviews, reading list, reminders, and detailed statistics. All data is stored locally in Markdown files — no external database required. Single container, includes a Docker healthcheck. Note: single-user app with no login by design — anyone who can reach the port can access it, so keep it on your home network or behind a VPN/reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for your tasks, settings, and stats (Markdown files)
